items.q: Even John Lewis liable to stay two hours on one note.

ctx.x: Milt Jackson. He . . . They got that time. It’s remarkable, the tempos. Those records should be collected to see how that . . . They do that for hours. Even John Lewis liable to stay two hours on one note. That note is just . . . he’s for that. The rest of them ain’t for that, but he’s the leader, so you going with the [? (inaudible)].
Tell us a little bit more about your years with Cab.
